description: This file defines the WidgetFactory class responsible for managing and instantiating widget components within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading standard widgets, registering custom widgets, and creating widget instances based on XML elements.

classes.name: WidgetFactory
classes.description: A utility class for loading, registering, and creating widget instances based on XML elements within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModelScreenWidget
methods.description: Creates and returns a ModelScreenWidget instance based on the provided XML element and model screen.

methods.name: loadStandardWidgets
methods.description: Loads the default set of OFBiz screen widgets into the factory.

methods.name: registerScreenWidget
methods.description: Registers a new widget class with a specific XML tag name, replacing existing ones if necessary.
